title: Minecraft But There Are RPG's
description:
Five rocket launchers. One mission. Maximum destruction.
Craft your way from a humble iron tube to a reality-warping Neon Launcher — fully survival-friendly, fully explosive.
body:
# 🚀 Minecraft RPGs

**Five launchers. One ammo type. Infinite destruction.**

Minecraft RPGs brings a fully survival-friendly rocket launcher progression system to Fabric — no mods, no commands, no cheats. Just iron, gunpowder, and a willingness to make things explode.

Craft your first humble M1 Launcher from iron ingots and sticks, and work your way up through increasingly devastating tiers until you're wielding the **Neon Launcher** — a reality-bending weapon that tears the landscape apart with chain explosions and incendiary chaos.

Built by **Prism Studios** — creators of NexusHUD, GhostSwap, and Prism's Crystal.

---

# 🔫 The Launchers

## 🔩 M1 Launcher — *The Beginning*
Your entry point into rocket warfare. Cheap to craft, satisfying to fire.
- Explosion Radius: **2.5 blocks**
- Rocket Speed: **1.8 b/t**
- Reload Time: **1.5s**

## 💥 RPG-7 — *The Classic*
Iconic. Reliable. Leaves a respectable crater.
- Explosion Radius: **4.0 blocks**
- Rocket Speed: **2.4 b/t**
- Reload Time: **2.0s**

## 🏔️ Titan Launcher — *The Workhorse*
When you need serious firepower without selling your soul for Netherite.
- Explosion Radius: **6.0 blocks**
- Rocket Speed: **2.8 b/t**
- Reload Time: **2.75s**

## 🔥 Destroyer — *The Incendiary*
Blaze Rod-forged and obsidian-hardened. What it doesn't blow up, it burns.
- Explosion Radius: **8.5 blocks**
- Rocket Speed: **3.2 b/t**
- Reload Time: **3.5s**
- Special: **Leaves fire on impact**

## ⚡ Neon Launcher — *The End Game*
Crafted from Echo Shards, Netherite, and Amethyst. It doesn't just explode — it *cascades*. Three chain blasts ripple outward from every impact, each one incendiary.
- Explosion Radius: **12.0 blocks**
- Rocket Speed: **3.8 b/t**
- Reload Time: **4.5s**
- Special: **Incendiary + Chain Explosions**

> All launchers share a single ammo type: **Rocket Ammo** (max stack: 16). Creative Mode bypasses ammo entirely.

---

# 🛠️ Crafting Recipes

## 🔩 M1 Launcher
```text
  I
 IS
IS
```
`I` = Iron Ingot · `S` = Stick

## 💥 RPG-7
```text
  I
TIG
I
```
`I` = Iron Ingot · `T` = TNT · `G` = Gunpowder

## 🏔️ Titan Launcher
```text
  I
BII
IB
```
`I` = Iron Ingot · `B` = Blaze Rod

## 🔥 Destroyer
```text
  N
BON
OB
```
`O` = Obsidian · `B` = Blaze Rod · `N` = Netherite Ingot

## ⚡ Neon Launcher
```text
  E
NAE
AN
```
`E` = Echo Shard · `N` = Netherite Ingot · `A` = Amethyst Shard

## 🎯 Rocket Ammo
```text
 I
IGI
 G
```
`I` = Iron Ingot · `G` = Gunpowder · **Crafts 4 ammo**

---

# ⚙️ Features

- 🎯 **Five-tier progression** — from scrap iron to endgame devastation
- 💣 **Dedicated ammo system** — one rocket ammo type, shared across all launchers
- 🛡️ **Self-damage resistance** — scales up with each tier so late-game launchers don't kill you
- 🔒 **Rocket arming distance** — rockets arm after 5–10 blocks, so you won't blow yourself up at close range
- 🔥 **Incendiary explosions** — Destroyer and Neon leave fire in their wake
- ⚡ **Neon chain blasts** — three secondary explosions ripple outward on every Neon hit
- 🎮 **Respects `/gamerule mobGriefing false`** — disable terrain destruction without disabling damage
- 🔊 **Unique fire and explosion sounds** per launcher tier
- 🌍 **Fully multiplayer compatible** — tested on server and client

---

# 📋 Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft** | 1.21 – 1.21.1 |
| **Mod Loader** | Fabric Loader 0.17.0+ |
| **Dependencies** | Fabric API *(required)* |
| **Environment** | Client + Server |

---

# ❓ FAQ

**Can I use this in modpacks?**
Yes — Minecraft RPGs is MIT licensed. Include it freely with credit.

**Does it work in multiplayer?**
Yes, fully. Both client and server are supported.

**Will rockets destroy my base?**
By default, yes. To protect terrain:
```mcfunction
/gamerule mobGriefing false
```

**Is there a config?**
Not in v1.0.0 — configuration support is planned for a future update.
